Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on S-nitrosylation (SNO), a redox-based modification. Two distinct enrichment strategies were used: SNOTRAP (biotin-streptavidin based) and organomercury-chemoselective columns. The organomercury method specifically uses performic acid to generate a sulfonic acid (trioxidation) signature on cysteines for site identification.

scope: SNOTRAP-labeling stock solutions prepared in acetonitrile (ACN) were added to samples at a final concentration of 1.5 mM to selectively convert SNO to stable disulfide-iminophosphorane.
After enzymatic digestion into peptides, 200 µL Streptavidin agarose beads were added to each sample and incubated for 2 hr at RT with gentle shaking.
Peptides bound to beads were then eluted with 10 mM TCEP (in 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.7)
S-nitrosoproteins and SNO-sites were assessed by MS after enrichment on a chemoselective-organomercury column.
